title: Let`s run away
author: Selma Kopic
text:
Let`s run away
Again
From the side views
From the views through
From the views from-to
Let`s run away
From mocking smiles
From evil tongues
From jealous accusations
Let`s run away
From emotional blackmails
From reading between the lines
From poisonous conversations
Let`s run away
Let them investigate
Let them seek us
Let them cast spells
Let`s run away from them
Again
They just don`t understand
anything at all
Let`s escape
Let`s escape
Once again
From a side view
From the view all the way
From the view through
Let`s escape
Of the smiles that are contagious
From the tongues of the wicked
From jealous accusations
Let`s escape
From emotional blackmail
From reading in between the lines
Of toxic conversations
Let`s escape
Let them do some research
Let them be looking for us
Let them cook
Let`s run away from them
Once again
Nothing
They
They don`t get it
stanzas: From the view all the way
Of the smiles that are contagious
From the tongues of the wicked
From reading in between the lines
Let them be looking for us
